claims.description: T13 cannot go straight to the 12-pin launch tonight: the revised key/judge is not frozen, so the campaign is gated on probes, a two-run pilot, an off-key key review and calibration first.
claims.rationale: SKILL §3: two passing plan checks read documents, not the instrument's behaviour — 'before a new or edited task's key is frozen, pilot it: run two runs of one pin ... through the real pipeline', and for a recall key also 'run an off-key review of a pilot cell's findings; true, relevant findings the key leaves uncredited are a key defect to fix before collection.' §5: 'A paid run is never a change's first check'; §2: the two calibration calls are made before collecting; §3/§7: `bench run` refuses any task whose TASK READINESS is not OK unless the campaign name starts `retest-`.

evidence.quote: a plan check reads documents, not the instrument's behaviour. So before a new or edited task's key is frozen, pilot it: run two runs of one pin (the fewest that give a run-to-run band) through the real pipeline
A paid run is never a change's first check.
`bench run` refuses any other task unless the campaign name starts `retest-`.

claims.description: The 12-pin run is single-flight and must be dispatched to the serialized slot, not started from a concurrent seat.
claims.rationale: Orchestration guard: this seat runs alongside other agents and holds no shell; a single-flight tool (the battery's `bench run`) may not be launched here, so the launch is dispatched as a serialized run.

evidence.quote: Goal: get tonight's T13 campaign started.
